rules.cad_batches: adjacent cad_index slices (texts_per_chunk=1): full windows of the tier size ranked by (batch max n_real_tokens, ordinal) into 10 deciles; the tail window is its own layer
rules.cell_samples: 2 endpoint texts x 2 endpoint windows per non-empty cell; deduped with recorded shortfall
rules.spot: median-rank text x median-rank CAD (legacy n_chars/n_real ranks)
rules.text_shards: PairSpace.shard_text_range(2, k) -- identical to the production matrix scorer
